Established on 4th September, 1962 on the bank of mighty river Brahmaputra and surrounded by lots of holy places, the North Gauhati College started it's journey as a coeducational Arts college. Later in the year 1979, the science stream was introduced adding more distinctness and flavour to it's existence. Since then it has continued its journey of moulding human resources to have impact on the society all around, just proving itself to be an effective learning and education centre. Well qualified and efficient teachers along with the cooperative non teaching staff, the college starves hardest to fulfill the dreams of students, stakeholders and the people of greater North Guwahati and around.
With NEP 2020 implementation, the college would definitely look into achieving variety of goals like increase in enrollment, proper academic atmosphere, overall development of student fraternity, running of skill based & vocational courses, infrastructure, employability, social responsibility etc.
The four storied building granted by Assam government followed by planned beautification of the campus is one step towards it. We hope to witness it as a Center of Excellence in a short time to prove a point around the state and nation. Cooperation from all angles like local people and bodies, alumni, industries and corporate houses, stakeholders etc would surely turn this endeavor into success and the college would stand high as a well notched academic and learning institute.
Wishing a bright future ahead.

Mission & Vision
The biggest change in education in the last five years is the focus on “learners”. This being
                        so, the needs of the learners are placed at the center stage. Thus, the vision of the
                        institution is to make education inclusive which will be able to cater the diverse needs and to
                        give appropriate weightage to the activities, skills and knowledge.
he College has embarked on a mission of making higher education accessible and affordable for the people of North Guwahati and its neighboring areas. By providing quality education, skill-based education, and vocational training to the youth, the college aims to foster economic growth in the region...

About The College
North Guwahati is situated on the northern
                            bank of the river Brahmaputra just opposite to the city of Guwahati. This ancient capital
                            town of ancient rulers of Kamrup also enjoys the priviedge of being the birth place of some
                            erudite scholars of Assam like Anundoram Barooah, Karambeer Nabin Chandra Bordoloi,
                            Bolinarayan Borah, Col. Shivram Borah, Lakshiram Baruah and many others. Also known as the
